authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 1111 āṇḍa includes aṇḍā/āṇā egg and deformations with ṭ or lateral articulation. The uncomplicated nasal-stop forms fit; rhotic, initial h or additional -ī patterns are kept for their own branch/morphology review. Reviewed comparison: Rana aɖa “egg” (f_nza3ntfkpxx6o). Possible intra-IA borrowing remains open under the user’s policy; exact source forms are retained.
